_: Where this copy of the site lives. Every url it writes — the canonical tags, og:url, the JSON-LD, the sitemap, what IndexNow is told, and the host the recitations stream from — is built from here, so moving to another domain is this file and `npm run build:pages`. Nothing in public/js reads it: the reader asks for its own paths and takes the audio host from the meta tag this fills in.
_audio: Empty serves the recitations from /surah, which is what a fresh checkout needs with no bucket set up.
